_comment: Maps a university study field to the career paths whose required skills a graduate of
that field is assumed to know. Used only when a mentor has no stated expertise terms.
This is a reviewed mapping, not a derived artefact. Study fields are created by
administrators as free text and are institution-specific, so a fuzzy match would quietly
mis-map a field rather than admit it did not recognise it. A field that is absent here
produces no inferred skills at all and the mentor is ranked on seniority alone, which is
the honest outcome — better than confidently matching them to the wrong students.
Keys are matched case-insensitively after collapsing whitespace. Values must be exact
